LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 9.1.1 PRESENTATION SKILLS – SONGS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.1: Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation skills – Songs
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation skills – Songs, part of Strand 9 in Grade 8 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: How can we make a presentation more appealing? 2. Why is correct intonation a key aspect in oral presentations?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. take turns to read target words with correct intonation to bring out meaning,

2. work collaboratively to sing songs related to the theme,

3. identify vocabulary from the songs,

4. create a list of the vocabulary identified,

5. use the vocabulary to compose a song on the theme One Kenya, One Nation,

6. present the song and work jointly with peers to record the performances,

7. organise an indigenous languages festival and exhibition to present the songs in the session. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. take turns to read target words with correct intonation to bring out meaning,
2. work collaboratively to sing songs related to the theme,
3. identify vocabulary from the songs,
4. create a list of the vocabulary identified,
5. use the vocabulary to compose a song on the theme One Kenya, One Nation,
6. present the song and work jointly with peers to record the performances,
7. organise an indigenous languages festival and exhibition to present the songs in the session. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation skills – Songs together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: The learner works jointly to read target words with correct intonation to bring meaning.

• Digital literacy: This is promoted as the learner uses digital technology to work with peers to record the performances.

Values:
• Unity: This is nurtured as the learner cooperates with peers to sing songs related to the theme.

• Patriotism: This is instilled as the learner works with others to compose a song on the theme One Kenya, One Nation.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social cohesion is enhanced as learner interacts with songs and even composes songs that promote inter-ethnic cohesion.

Links to other Learning Areas:
The learner is able to relate the concept of inter-ethnic cohesion to the concept of nationalism in Social Studies.
